## Fees & Charges  
**Premium Account Fee:** £0.00 (offset by higher rates)
**All Other Fees:** Same as SmartSaver Account
name: Chunk 13/34

raw_entities.name: Premium Account
raw_entities.description: A premium savings product offered by FirstUK Bank with no monthly account fee, offset by higher interest rates compared to standard accounts. Shares fee structure with SmartSaver Account for all charges beyond the account maintenance fee.
context: Premium Account Fee: £0.00 (offset by higher rates)
All Other Fees: Same as SmartSaver Account

raw_entities.name: SmartSaver Account
raw_entities.description: A standard savings account product referenced as the fee benchmark for Premium Account. All fees applicable to Premium Account beyond the account maintenance fee are identical to SmartSaver Account.
context: All Other Fees: Same as SmartSaver Account

raw_entities.name: Premium Account Monthly Maintenance Fee
raw_entities.description: No monthly maintenance fee charged on the Premium Account. The absence of this fee is explicitly called out as a feature, with the benefit offset by higher interest rates offered on the product.
context: Premium Account Fee: £0.00 (offset by higher rates)

raw_entities.name: Higher Interest Rate Benefit
raw_entities.description: A premium feature of the Premium Account that offsets the £0.00 monthly maintenance fee through elevated interest rates compared to standard savings products.
